title: a commit made in a linked worktree measures its closure at the repo's real top
intention: The pre-commit reseal holds a proof only when the commit truly lacks part of its closure, in a linked worktree as in a main checkout (restoring 42075a49c121; 143e3974647b's adoption untouched).
why: Measured 2026-11-13: commit 2cab01ad3 in linked worktree /home/akien/dev/src/cairn-q95 printed 'reseal: 20 held', each HELD line naming unmodified files (inspector.py, __init__.py, the proof) as unstaged. In a worktree the hook carries GIT_DIR, under which `git -C <proofs dir> rev-parse --show-toplevel` answers the proofs dir; diff from there lists every tracked file (scratch repo /home/akien/.akien/temp/heldprobe.reDb). PROVED 42075a49c121 is red in worktrees.
traces_to: Law 8 (a seal describes the committed tree; a false hold leaves it unwritten) and Law 7 (a HELD line naming unmodified files is a wrong record).
how: The index_only branch asks rev-parse --show-toplevel with GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE dropped and GIT_INDEX_FILE kept; a new tooth runs the predicate in a scratch linked worktree under the hook's GIT_DIR.

clauses.claim: in a scratch linked worktree, with GIT_DIR set as its pre-commit hook sets it, a proof whose closure is unmodified is not held (red on HEAD's reseal.py)
in the same worktree, a closure file with an unstaged change is held and the hold names that file and no unmodified file
the four teeth of 42075a49c121 in the same proof stay green

decisions.text: D1: in reseal()'s index_only branch the rev-parse --show-toplevel call runs with an env copied from os.environ minus GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE; GIT_INDEX_FILE stays so the commit's index is what is measured. dirty_against_index is unchanged.

D2: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_seal_measures_what_the_commit_carries.py gains two teeth under this ticket's PROVES key (clauses 1, 2): a scratch repo (git init, commit a component and proof, git worktree add) and the predicate run with GIT_DIR=<main>/.git/worktrees/<name>, as the hook carries it; clause 3 is the proof's four existing 42075a49c121 teeth.

out: the hook script cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit; stage_clean_seals; what a hold means (42075a49c121)

measured.saw: 20 seals held in worktree cairn-q95, every HELD line naming unmodified files; the same predicate run outside the hook read clean; in a scratch worktree, GIT_DIR set made show-toplevel answer the subdirectory and diff list every unmodified file
measured.how: git commit -- <paths> in /home/akien/dev/src/cairn-q95; scratchpad held_probe.sh over a scratch repo
